definitions.frame: frame0=reset; command index i produces observation frame i+1; flip assigned to newer command frame
definitions.flip: adjacent actually executed raw gripper threshold classes differ; nonnegative -> +1; negative -> -1; actual handed flips cross-checked
definitions.opportunities: N-1 adjacent executed-command pairs; exclude reset-to-first-command; boundary if chunk differs
definitions.phase: first maxabs(observation.force[:,12:16])>1 N is c; pre f<c-10, near c-10<=f<=c+10, post f>c+10; absent c separate
definitions.raw_class: small: both abs<=0.1; large: both abs>=0.3; otherwise mixed; classified for all eligible pairs
definitions.opening: observation.state[:,7] measured normalized opening; delta>1e-4 opening, <-1e-4 closing, otherwise stationary
definitions.force: wrist norm is ONLY observation.force[:,0:3]; NOT all six model force channels; pads=12:16; no full18 norm across mixed force/torque channels
definitions.posture: both EEF xyz and normalized quaternion geodesic from reset, absolute quaternion dot; no Euler-angle inference
definitions.rail: descriptive normalized command rail abs>=1-1e-6 in handed/requested XYZ or first6 ONLY; excludes gripper dims6,13; not physical workspace/joint limit
definitions.windows: for newer flip command frame f, before=f-1, after=f; pre window f-10..f-1, post f..f+10, truncated to observed bounds
definitions.chunk: incoming boundary belongs to destination chunk; each opportunity counted once
